welcome.title: Welcome to Church Hub
welcome.description: A few choices to set Church Hub up for your church. You can change all of them later in Settings.

features.title: What will you use?
features.description: Pick the pages you need. The others are hidden from the side menu; you can bring them back anytime in Settings › Sidebar.

items.present: Show songs, verses and announcements on the screens
items.songs: Search, edit and present the songs
items.schedules: Plan the order of the service
items.livestream: Run the live stream on YouTube with OBS
items.music: Play music before and after the service
items.song_key: The key each song was sung in
items.live_translation: Translate the sermon live for listeners
items.feedback: Send ideas and problems to the Church Hub team
